summary: Ann Arbor, Michigan, former board member of the Inter-Cooperative Council, strong advocate for student-athlete welfare and integrity in college sports, critical of sensationalist sports bloggers, experienced in business management and corporate leadership, knowledgeable about college football history, enjoys watching football, particularly University of Michigan games, believes in the importance of community and democratic institutions, holds progressive political views, emphasizes compassion and kindness in interpersonal interactions, interested in critical thinking and combating misinformation, has a technical background in IT, engaged in discussions about social justice and human rights.
